articles.summary: Revenue increased 6% year-over-year, driven by more asphalt paving and aggregate demand Aggregate margin improved by 240 basis points to a third quarter record 29.6% Announced 'Sharper EDGE' initiatives, focused on targeted improvements to drive meaningful growth Updated 2026 guidance to reflect near-term headwinds Knife River Corporation (NYSE: KNF), an aggregates-based, vertically integrated construction materials and contracting services company, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
